firm_data.firm_description: Osler is a leading business law firm practicing internationally from offices across Canada and New York. The firm is recognized for providing business-critical advice and counsel in key industry sectors, and in transactions and litigation for some of the world’s largest enterprises.
notable_facts: The firm has offices in Toronto, Calgary, Montréal, Ottawa, Vancouver and New York.

ai_contact.ai_notes: Osler published an article on 'how Canada should approach AI regulation' [osler.com](https://www.osler.com/en/).

email.subject: AI for Osler, Hoskin & Harcourt LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Douglas,

Osler's recent article on how Canada should approach AI regulation signals what we're seeing across leading firms: forward-thinking leaders are asking the right questions about AI, not avoiding it. We've built Lucio specifically for that mindset.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Toronto to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
